description: This file defines the Job model and related constants, types, and methods for handling background jobs in the Mattermost server, including job types, statuses, validation, and YAML serialization.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a background job with properties such as ID, type, status, progress, and timestamps. Includes methods for validation, YAML serialization, and cloning.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of the job's properties for auditing purposes.

methods.name: MarshalYAML
methods.description: Serializes the Job object into a YAML-compatible structure with formatted timestamps.

methods.name: UnmarshalYAML
methods.description: Deserializes YAML data into a Job object, parsing timestamps.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the Job's ID, creation timestamp, and status.

methods.name: IsValidStatusChange
methods.description: Checks if a transition from the current status to a new status is valid.

methods.name: LogClone
methods.description: Returns a clone of the job's audit data.
